text:
- **Owner questions:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site or in chat, and the first answer wins. Owner replies now reach a session by push alone, since the reply wait and inbox are removed.
- **Records layer:** The owner chose Model A for the record layer design, and the design is recorded. The site now renders the records branch, and each draft has its own page with diffs.
- **Checks and CI:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Pull requests run a faster diff-mode check, and the full grading runs daily on main.
- **Repo setup:** This repo now runs the new pm release, and pm no longer installs a git hook. Claude Code auto memory is now off in this repo.
